2608.31105.title: BLOOM-WILT: Logit Tilting for Behaviour Elicitation in Automated LLM Auditing
2608.31105.paper_summary: Users of a deployed language model routinely encounter behaviours that testing almost never surfaces, since deployment puts the model through orders of magnitude more interactions than any evaluation can simulate. Automated auditors make testing cheap to scale and flexible enough to cover almost any specified behaviour, yet their lack of optimisation pressure makes them sample-inefficient. To address this shortcoming, we introduce BLOOM-WILT, a full auditing pipeline that elicits natural multi-turn instances of rare behaviours, without training cost or access beyond the target's next-token distribution. On the input side, WILT's auditor model revises its conversational strategy across rounds, learning from previous scored interactions. On the output side, WILT adaptively reweights the target's decoding using the model's own distribution conditioned on an elicitation prompt, so that behaviour-relevant generations are sampled ahead of others it finds equally probable when unprompted. We evaluate WILT across 4 target models and 8 behaviours, where it beats the baseline auditor in 30 of the 32 settings and overturns the previous model safety rankings. WILT raises average behaviour presence from 51% to 100% when eliciting self-harm encouragement from Qwen3.5-4B, beating every elicitation method we port into the same pipeline at matched compute, without pushing output probability below the baseline's.
2608.31105.paper_summary_zh: 使用已部署的語言模型的用戶經常會遇到測試幾乎無法發現的行為，因為部署使模型經歷的互動次數比任何評估能夠模擬的要多出幾個數量級。自動化審計員使得測試變得便宜且靈活，幾乎可以涵蓋任何指定的行為，但它們缺乏優化壓力，使得樣本效率低下。為了解決這一缺陷，我們引入了BLOOM-WILT，一個完整的審計管道，能夠引出自然的多輪稀有行為實例，無需訓練成本或超出目標的下一個標記分佈的訪問。在輸入端，WILT的審計模型在多輪中修正其對話策略，從之前的評分互動中學習。在輸出端，WILT根據引出提示，自適應地重新加權目標的解碼，從而使與行為相關的生成在未提示時被優先抽樣，而不是與其他同樣可能的生成相提並論。我們在4個目標模型和8種行為上評估WILT，結果顯示它在32個設置中有30個超越了基準審計員，並顛覆了之前的模型安全排名。當從Qwen3.5-4B引出自我傷害鼓勵時，WILT將平均行為存在率從51%提高到100%，超越了我們移植到同一管道中的每一種引出方法，且在匹配計算的情況下，輸出概率未低於基準的水平。
2608.31105.author: Adrians Skapars et.al.
